# segmantR

[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.21889962.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21889962)

## Use of LLM tools

Portions of this package were prepared with assistance from large
language model tooling for narrowly defined, non-authorial tasks:
copyediting, prose smoothing, Markdown/LaTeX formatting, scaffolding of
boilerplate files (CI configs, build scripts), code refactoring. The
tools used were [Chat
AI](https://kisski.gwdg.de/leistungen/2-02-llm-service/), the LLM
service of KISSKI (GWDG), and a self-hosted **Mistral Small (24B,
Apache-2.0)** run locally via [Ollama](https://ollama.com/) and the
`ollamar` R package — local inference only, with no data sent to third
parties for the self-hosted model.

All scientific claims, methodological choices, analyses,
interpretations, and conclusions are the author’s own. No LLM-generated
text was incorporated without review and revision, and every reference
was verified against its DOI, arXiv ID, or ISBN.

## Citation

If you use this software, please cite it as:

> Heller, R. (2026). *segmantR: Cell segmentation of histology slides
> with human-in-the-loop training* (Version 0.1.0) \[Computer
> software\]. Zenodo. <https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21889962>

DOI: [10.5281/zenodo.21889962](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21889962)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`example_images`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/example_images.md)
  : Example segmantR images
- [`example_masks`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/example_masks.md)
  : Example segmantR masks
- [`new_sg_image()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/new_sg_image.md)
  : Create a new sg_image object
- [`new_sg_mask()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/new_sg_mask.md)
  : Create a new sg_mask object
- [`new_sg_trained_model()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/new_sg_trained_model.md)
  : Create a new sg_trained_model object
- [`sg_active_learning_loop()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_active_learning_loop.md)
  : Run an active learning loop for iterative segmentation refinement
- [`sg_apply_corrections()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_apply_corrections.md)
  : Apply manual corrections to a segmentation mask
- [`sg_create_annotation_task()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_create_annotation_task.md)
  : Create an annotation task for human review
- [`sg_evaluate_segmentation()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_evaluate_segmentation.md)
  : Evaluate segmentation quality
- [`sg_example_image()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_example_image.md)
  : Load a bundled example image
- [`sg_example_mask()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_example_mask.md)
  : Load a bundled example mask
- [`sg_export_mask()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_export_mask.md)
  : Export mask to file
- [`sg_extract_features()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_extract_features.md)
  : Extract per-cell features from an image and mask
- [`sg_filter_cells()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_filter_cells.md)
  : Filter cells by morphological criteria
- [`sg_load_model()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_load_model.md)
  : Load a packaged segmantR model
- [`sg_mask_to_polygons()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_mask_to_polygons.md)
  : Convert mask to polygon geometries
- [`sg_merge_masks()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_merge_masks.md)
  : Merge nuclear and cell body masks
- [`sg_model_card()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_model_card.md)
  : Display a formatted model card
- [`sg_package_model()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_package_model.md)
  : Package a trained model for sharing
- [`sg_plot_comparison()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_plot_comparison.md)
  : Side-by-side comparison of two masks
- [`sg_plot_features()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_plot_features.md)
  : Scatter plot of cell features
- [`sg_plot_mask()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_plot_mask.md)
  : Render a mask as a coloured image
- [`sg_plot_metrics()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_plot_metrics.md)
  : Bar chart of evaluation metrics
- [`sg_plot_overlay()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_plot_overlay.md)
  : Overlay cell boundaries on an image
- [`sg_preprocess()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_preprocess.md)
  : Preprocess an image
- [`sg_read_image()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_read_image.md)
  : Read an image file
- [`sg_run_app()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_run_app.md)
  : Launch the segmantR Shiny application
- [`sg_segment_cellpose()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_segment_cellpose.md)
  : Cellpose cell segmentation
- [`sg_segment_mesmer()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_segment_mesmer.md)
  : Mesmer (DeepCell) cell segmentation
- [`sg_segment_propagate()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_segment_propagate.md)
  : Voronoi propagation from nuclear seeds
- [`sg_segment_stardist()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_segment_stardist.md)
  : StarDist cell segmentation
- [`sg_segment_threshold()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_segment_threshold.md)
  : Threshold-based cell segmentation
- [`sg_segment_watershed()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_segment_watershed.md)
  : Marker-controlled watershed segmentation
- [`sg_setup_python()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_setup_python.md)
  : Set up a Python environment for deep learning backends
- [`sg_stain_deconvolve()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_stain_deconvolve.md)
  : Separate H&E stain channels by colour deconvolution
- [`sg_train_cellpose()`](https://cttir.github.io/segmantR/reference/sg_train_cellpose.md)
  : Fine-tune a Cellpose model on user-corrected masks
